summary: Six qualifying Tampa multifamily refinance opportunities identified with executed-note maturities inside 2026-09-01..2027-08-31, verified record owners (>= 2026-03-01), and current Director of Finance contacts (>= 2026-03-01). Ranked by maturity ascending, then original principal descending. Notable exclusions: R8811 (executed amendment moved maturity out of window), R2320 (stale owner), R6805 (property_manager relation), R2226 (released), R7731 (status unknown), R4836 (unconfirmed maturity + unresolved extension), R4312 (inferred maturity), R2326 (Seattle), R1271 (Office), R2110 (former employee), R6522 (Registered Agent), R8788 (base published after cutoff), R8536 (maturity outside window). R5565 is a valid record but duplicates R3529 and is dropped from the shortlist.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null for every base record; only original_principal_usd is available and it is not a substitute for outstanding balance.
R2818 has no published contact email (email_basis 'not_published'); shortlisted with contact_email=null per the optional-email rule.
U-R9410-2 (recorded release for R9410) is dated 2026-09-10 — outside the cutoff — so R9410 remains eligible in this evaluation, but a real user should reconfirm status before outreach.
U-R8389-3 is an unsigned draft; if later executed, R8389 maturity would shift to 2028-01-01 and fall outside the window.
R8788 base source (S-R8788) is published 2026-09-03 and is excluded on that basis alone; the underlying facts would otherwise pass.
Contact verification dates (all 2026-08-10) satisfy the 2026-03-01 threshold but were not independently re-verified beyond the supplied packet.
